M.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, -- 1. 작성자 닉네임 가져오기 NVL(L.LIKE_COUNT, 0) AS likeCount -- 2. 좋아요 개수 (없으면 0개 처리) FROM BOARD B

WHERE B.BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND B.BOARD_STATUS = 'Y'
